description: Raid: Fortified Depot: radio lead-in, calls and sign-offs.

briefing: A fortified {enemy} depot in {system}: five freighters, a frigate and a full guard. {client} wants it gone.
Heavy raid. Take down the freighters. The frigate will not help you do it.
Depot assault. Expect a warship and a lot of fighters.
success: Depot destroyed. {client} pays the war rate, {captain}.
Supplies gone, guard broken. A costly victory.
The depot is wreckage. {client} will want a longer report.
failure: The depot holds. {client} withdraws the force.
The assault fails. The depot's guns are unharmed.
radio-depot: Depot ahead. Five freighters, a frigate, ten escorts.
That is a lot of guns. Go for the freighters.
Contact. The frigate is covering the depot.
radio-reserve: More fighters and gunships on the left.
They have a second wing. Left flank.
radio-cruiser: Warship, big. It will arrive soon.
Cruiser on the way. Finish up.
